For pump size NOWC 80160 AC 501 0B 3 1 with coupling finish bored on motor side and with
coupling guard the full order number is
NOWC 80160 AC 501 0B 3 1 41
For pump size NOWC 80160 AC 501 0B 3 1 as complete unit with 18.5 kW three phase motor, 2900 rpm,
the full order number is
NOWC 80160 AC 501 0B 3 1 UA
When ordering the extent of supply corresponding to 41 and 53, please state the motor selected in all cases so that the coupling can
be finish bored on the motor side, the correct bedplate selected and the right shims provided.
